text: The about:rights privacy fix changes the href to Thunderbird policy while retaining the mozilla-privacy-policy-link overlay name. Preserve the localized slot identity when correcting a destination unless the Fluent consumer is changed too. That local page is retired at the accepted endpoint, where rights redirects to a hosted page; this is a historical overlay pattern, not current hosted markup or legal-policy validation. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Preserve a localization overlay slot while correcting its link target
